feature: One script tag sends a page view with URL and referrer; it is stored in ClickHouse within 35 s (the dashboard side is D1)
check: pnpm --dir apps/tracker test && uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -m e2e tests/e2e/test_pipeline.py

feature: SPA navigation (history.pushState to a new path) sends one page view; a query-string-only change does not
check: pnpm --dir apps/tracker test && uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -m e2e tests/e2e/test_pipeline.py

feature: Custom events with properties; calls made before the script loaded are sent once it loads
check: pnpm --dir apps/tracker test && uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -m e2e tests/e2e/test_pipeline.py

feature: Automated browsers (navigator.webdriver = true) send nothing
check: pnpm --dir apps/tracker test && uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -m e2e tests/e2e/test_pipeline.py

feature: Events for an unknown domain get 202 with X-Mieru-Dropped: unknown_site and are not stored
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/unit/ingest tests/integration/ingest -k unknown_site

feature: Bot user agents, spam referrers and over-limit traffic are dropped and counted per reason
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/unit/ingest tests/integration/ingest -k drop

feature: Each stored event has country, device, browser, OS, source and UTM tags
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/unit/ingest tests/unit/writer -k "country or enrich"

feature: Events less than 30 minutes apart are one session; a 31-minute gap starts a new one; midnight UTC does not split a session
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/writer/test_sessions.py

feature: Headline numbers (visitors, visits, page views, bounce rate, visit duration) for every period, in the site's timezone
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/stats -k "aggregate or timeseries" && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep dashboard

feature: Trend chart by hour (ranges up to 2 days) or by day
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/stats -k "aggregate or timeseries" && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep dashboard

feature: Top sources, UTM tags, pages, entry/exit pages, countries, devices, browsers and OS, 10 rows each with show more
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/stats -k "breakdown or realtime" && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep dashboard

feature: Current visitors (last 5 minutes) refreshes every 30 s without reloading
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/stats -k "breakdown or realtime" && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep dashboard

feature: Goals on an event name or page path, with conversions and conversion rate
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/api -k goals

feature: Clicking a breakdown row filters the whole dashboard; filters live in the URL
check: pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep filter

feature: A secret link shows a read-only dashboard without login; revoking it breaks the link
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/api -k sharing

feature: Comparison with the previous period, CSV export of any breakdown, read-only Stats API with API keys
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -k "compare or csv or stats_api"

feature: Sign up, verify email by link, log in, log out; the session lasts 30 days and ends at once on logout
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/api/test_auth.py && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep auth

feature: Adding a domain shows the snippet; the install check turns green after the first event
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/api/test_sites.py && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e --grep onboarding

feature: Settings show events used this month vs quota and sites used vs the site limit
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/worker/test_usage.py

feature: Stripe Checkout (test mode) upgrades the plan within a minute; the customer portal cancels it
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/api/test_billing.py

feature: A spike alert fires once per hour at most; a weekly report arrives Monday morning in my timezone
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/worker/test_alerts.py

feature: Alerts go to email addresses, each verified before use
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest tests/integration/worker/test_notifications.py

feature: A deploy under steady traffic loses no events: sent and stored counts match
check: ops/drills/deploy-under-traffic.sh (run against the server; exits 0 when sent == stored)

feature: Last night's backups restore onto a fresh server and the row counts match
check: ops/backup/restore-check.sh (run after a restore drill; exits 0 when counts match)

feature: No IP address or raw user agent appears in Redis, ClickHouse, Postgres or logs after events are processed
check: uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -m e2e tests/e2e/test_privacy.py
